description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.10

- Fix Mention Preview Card Handle Duplication: When clicking channel mentions in titles or descriptions, the bottom sheet preview card will now properly keep the channel's actual handle (@handle) below the channel name instead of replacing it with the channel name.
- Support Video Title & Description Mentions: Replaces channel handle mentions (@handle) in video titles and description boxes with the actual channel name (@ChannelName), keeping the '@' symbol.
- Refined Subtitle Spacing: Spacing between channel name and view count under the video is separated by a clean single space.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle (~21 KB): Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
